scene: Living-room rug in the afternoon. A bin of building blocks sits at the rug's edge; a small plate with two berry cakes rests on the side table behind them. Child stands at screen-right and Peer at screen-left, both with empty hands. Locked 16:9 medium two-shot with both faces visible.

emotion.baseline: Calm, warm and regulated baseline. Both speak at a normal family volume with small, natural facial movements and gestures.
emotion.allowed_shift: Both friends show light, friendly energy while arranging; the mood stays calm and cooperative; the ending is happily ready.
emotion.forbidden: No exaggerated surprise, wide-eyed shock, bouncing, raised voices, impatience, blaming or teasing. Any disappointment, worry or sadness stays mild and brief, and the adult helps things stay steady.

clips.start: Child and Peer stand by the block bin with empty hands; the snack plate rests on the side table.
clips.action: Child opens with his invitation, gesturing once toward the block bin. Peer bounces once on his toes and asks about starting now.
clips.end: Both look toward the snack plate on the side table.

clips.start: Both look toward the snack plate on the side table.
clips.action: Child points at the plate, then at the bin, laying out the order. Peer rubs his tummy happily. Child points off-frame toward his room while saying where they will build.
clips.end: Both stand with relaxed hands, imagining the rug.

clips.start: Both stand with relaxed hands, imagining the rug.
clips.action: Peer stacks his hands high for the tall tower. Child points one finger straight up toward the ceiling for the flag; Peer opens his arms wide with delight and they share a small high five.
